summary_1line: Drunk on honey after Hanuman’s success, the monkeys ravage Madhuvana and clash with the enraged guardian Dadhimukha and his forest guards.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bands of intoxicated monkeys leap from tree to tree in Madhuvana, tearing honeycombs and flinging wax while laughing and shouting.
Dadhimukha, furious and elderly, charges forward brandishing a huge tree while his guards arm themselves with rocks and branches.
Drunken monkeys sprawl under the trees of the honey grove, some singing like lions roaring while others hurl combs and wrestle wildly.
